entries.title: 2026 Asian Games medal table
entries.headline: Asian Games medal table peaks as India finish with 85 medals on the penultimate day
entries.dek: On 3 October, the second-to-last day of Aichi–Nagoya 2026, India won cricket and hockey gold, and Japan won water polo and softball titles. China's lead at the top was never in doubt.

entries.title: Christa Pike
entries.headline: Christa Pike still unconscious on a ventilator days after Tennessee's failed execution
entries.dek: Her lawyers say she is critically ill in a Nashville-area hospital and has not woken since Wednesday's lethal injection. They say it could be several more days before anyone knows whether she will recover.

entries.title: India at the 2026 Asian Games
entries.headline: India's Asian Games page climbs again as cricket and hockey gold-medal finals arrive
entries.dek: On 3 October, the second-to-last day of Aichi-Nagoya 2026, India played Pakistan in the men's cricket final and Malaysia in the men's hockey final, with a Los Angeles 2028 Olympic place riding on the hockey.
